description: This Java class 'PointerLocationEvaluator' determines the relative location of a JSON pointer to a reference JSON pointer, classifying it as above, below, same, or different.

classes.name: PointerLocationEvaluator
classes.description: A final class implementing Function to evaluate the relative position of JSON pointers based on a reference pointer.

methods.name: PointerLocationEvaluator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the evaluator with a reference JSON pointer, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Determines the relative location of a given JSON pointer to the reference pointer, returning ABOVE, BELOW, SAME, or DIFFERENT.

methods.name: isOnReferencePointer
methods.description: Checks if a given JSON pointer is on the reference pointer by comparing each level's key.
